星哨StarWatch

Website monitoring · API checks

In development

A self-hosted scheduled monitoring platform for selected website and API fields, with historical comparisons.

Scheduling, content extraction, historical comparisons and notifications are implemented. The scheduler stores tasks and runs, the fetcher makes requests, and the frontend displays results. Deploy a single scheduler instance; see the README for full configuration.

Vue · FastAPI · MongoDBDocker ComposeMIT

Current status: Implementation code and Docker Compose setup are available. There is no official release or standalone installer yet.

Features and progress

  • Cron and interval scheduling for website monitoring, API assertions and short load tests
  • Extract HTML, JSON and text, and review additions, deletions and changes line by line
  • Tasks, run history, snapshots and notifications, with separate fetcher and scheduler processes

Platforms and distribution

Self-host as a web service and use it in a browser. There is no standalone desktop installer.

Start from source

These startup commands come from the repository README. Read the original documentation for dependencies and configuration.
